summary: Every requirement and ruling the plan owes a phase is delivered by P1 and provable in the tree: R1-R6 and the Go/runtime-stage, endpoint-path, architecture.yaml, tests-out-of-CI, two-routes and signature-wire-format rulings all land in DockerImages' webhook-relay/, and V13's hand-off contract for 009 is in the README. The three things the plan does not deliver are the three it explicitly assigns elsewhere — R7/V08 to the run loop's own doc phase (which has not run yet; test_rounds is 0), R5's leaf half and the chart manifests to 009, and the architecture consumption edge to 009 as close-out S2 — so none is outstanding work this loop owes a phase. The two real leftovers, B1 (V14's constant-time clause has no test behind it, and no non-flaky Go test can pin it) and B2 (HEAD /healthz answers 200 and POST /api//webhook answers 307, against V04's 'every other method is refused'), are already filed with full accounts and cost the operator one word each, well under the price of an executor round, a review round and a consult. Under the mechanical-residue exception I fixed close-out B3 in this session and struck it: the false 'the estate's only internet-facing service' claim in architecture.yaml, README.md and the Dockerfile, comment and prose only, corrected to the authoritative design's narrower claim and committed to DockerImages main as 6e01ede with the arch-validate and go test gates re-run green.
